question: Who is authorized to employ any substance brought into this circle?
premises: A substance may be brought by any person.
The substance is brought into this circle.
Employment of the substance in the circle is prescribed.
inference: Any person who brings a substance into this circle may employ it there.
uncertainties: The scope of dravyaṃ as ritual offering or general material is context-dependent.
plain_english: Whatever substance is brought by anyone into this circle should be employed there.
